text:
Ivy (PM): Quick sync  users in the beta were tripped up by different names: console shows 'Help drawer' but docs use 'In-product docs'. We should standardize and add links.
Theo (Design): Agree. My vote is to surface the canonical phrase from docs in the drawer body, not the compact header. Header can stay short.
Sam (Docs): Docs canonical term is 'In-product docs'. If UI keeps short header, please add the phrase and a link to /docs/glossary#in-product-docs in the drawer body. Also add a one-line explainer.
Rae (DevEx): Implementation notes: internal deep links supported but SPA router needs data-internal-link to respect anchors. Also update i18n key `drawer_title` to avoid translation mismatches.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: ensure header has aria-label='In-product docs' if visual label is shortened, and mark the explainer region with role=region and aria-live=polite when content changes.
Theo (Design): UX plan: keep visible header 'Help', first line inside body: 'In-product docs: contextual docs and links', then two explicit links: 'Glossary: In-product docs' and 'Guide: in-product docs usage'. Avoid generic 'Learn more'.
Sam (Docs): I'll add anchors: /docs/glossary#in-product-docs and /docs/guides/in-product-help#usage. I'll also add a short note: "Terms: the console may show 'Help drawer' elsewhere; 'In-product docs' is the canonical name."
Ivy (PM): Decisions: 1) Header remains 'Help' visually; 2) Body shows canonical 'In-product docs' + explainer; 3) Two explicit crosslinks to glossary and guide; 4) DevEx to support data-internal-link + aria-label; 5) Docs to add anchors and short note. Owners: Sam (docs), Rae (devex), Theo (design).
Rae (DevEx): I'll update internal-link handler and ensure target=_self for internal nav. ETA next sprint.
Sam (Docs): Opening PR now with anchor and copy. ETA 24h.
Theo (Design): Updating mock to show in-body canonical phrase and link text. I'll include mobile collapsing behavior for the links.
Ivy (PM): Great. Please run a quick a11y check after implementation. Closing after staging signoff. :white_check_mark:
